title: Duke Ellington Fellowship at Yale
summary: Edison counts the Yale fellowship among his proudest moments.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: He had more feeling than Harry James. He had more soul. Oh, he had more soul than Harry James, you know. But, you know, like one of my most prized possessions is that Duke Ellington fellowship to Yale University. Twenty of us got it for our contribution to jazz. And I tell you, I don't know, I've been lucky all my life and that was one of my luckiest moments, you know, to be asked to accept that, you know.
Yeah, well, that was a very nice thing. It's just a pity they were not able to continue it.
Yeah. It still -- I think it's still active. But it's not as active as it was.
